objective: Audit the current DR24-to-application and DR24-to-feature paths, then define a provenance-first labelled-cohort contract for the Park prototype without changing scientific code or artifacts.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The default normalized observation path uses ALeRCE. DR24 HATS retrieval is a separate native-data method.
The bounded DR24 adapter preserves HMJD, native magnitudes, errors, color coefficients and catflags. It does not normalize time or photometry, apply a QC mask, or group OIDs.
The frozen v0.2 pipeline requires MJD, fid, mag and magerr and emits the 42-feature contract. Preprocessing applies its own finite-value and positive-error rules.
Identity data contracts exist, but the module does not perform matching. The AOIC architecture remains proposed/not implemented.
ALeRCE 2020 is a candidate label manifest; acquisition, DR24 matching, taxonomy mapping and the 100,000-light-curve cohort remain unverified.

baseline.status: No scientific code, dataset, model, taxonomy, feature, threshold or acceptance criterion is changed.

change.scope: Documentation-only source-code audit and proposed manifest-first cohort/feature contract. No external data acquisition, code modification, feature extraction, model training or scientific gate execution is performed.
change.rationale: The application uses ALeRCE for normalized observations while DR24 HATS is exposed as a separate raw-native path. The existing v0.2 feature pipeline expects a different time and photometry contract. A direct mapping would be scientifically unsupported.

expected_improvement: Make the DR24-to-feature incompatibility explicit and trace it to exact source files and revisions.
Define separate label, cross-match, raw-lightcurve, feature and split manifests.
Define count reconciliation for label sources, HATS light curves and confirmed astrophysical source groups.
Prevent ambiguous associations, source leakage, silent data loss and accidental changes to the frozen v0.2.0 baseline.

correctness.reason: This is a source-code audit and contract proposal. No dataset was acquired and no feature mapping was tested.

reproducibility.reason: No live DR24/ALeRCE query, archive acquisition, or repeated cohort build was run.

scientific_validity.reason: No labels were cross-matched, no Park features were generated, and no model was trained or evaluated.

measurement.trade_off: The contract adds explicit gates before acquisition and training. It does not deliver the 100,000-light-curve dataset or a classifier.

evidence: Read the current main source files at exact revision 3ba78f93727edf79321baa2a1796a5eb37ba0782 and recorded their blob IDs in the audit document.
Verified that ObservationService.get_observations uses the ALeRCE backend and that DR24 retrieval is a separate native path.
Verified that extract_v0_2_features requires MJD, fid, mag and magerr and preserves the frozen 42-feature order.
Verified that DR24 HATS returns HMJD and native photometry fields without conversion or QC selection.
Verified that the source identity module defines contracts only and does not perform cross-matching.
Added the proposed cohort and feature-compatibility contract at docs/acceptance/PARK_DR24_COHORT_AND_FEATURE_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT_2026-11-25.md.
No external acquisition, data download, cross-match, feature run, or model training was performed.
validation.blocker: Acquire and verify the labelled source manifest through the approved manual workflow, implement and validate the cross-match ledger, approve the DR24 time/photometry/QC/feature contract, and then run bounded source-backed tests.

root_causes: The current application defaults to ALeRCE normalized observations; DR24 HATS is not wired into the normalized feature path.
DR24 HATS uses HMJD and native magnitudes, while the frozen v0.2 feature pipeline expects MJD and ALeRCE-normalized photometry.
The current source identity module contains data contracts but no matching implementation or accepted cross-filter source grouping.
The 100,000 target is stated in light curves, while source labels and HATS records have different grains.
unresolved: Actual ALeRCE archive schema, row count, class counts and hashes must be verified after acquisition.
ALeRCE label-to-DR24 match rate and ambiguity distribution are unknown.
The approved count basis and DR24 QC eligibility policy remain to be confirmed.
No DR24 feature mapping or parity evidence exists.
The original v0.2.0 production model artifact remains blocked under Issue #282.

findings: A DR24 raw record must not be relabelled as an ALeRCE-normalized observation by column renaming.
A 100,000 label-source count is not equivalent to 100,000 DR24 light curves or 100,000 unique astrophysical sources.
Count light curves, source groups, ambiguous matches and retrieval failures separately.
Split by confirmed astrophysical source group to prevent cross-filter leakage.
Keep any new Park model and feature schema separate from the frozen v0.2.0 baseline.

open_blockers: Review the cohort count interpretation and schema before implementation.
Acquire and hash the ALeRCE 2020 labelled archive through the explicit manual acquisition gate.
Implement deterministic label-to-DR24 candidate generation and ambiguity-preserving association tests.
Add DR24-native feature contract and numerical tests without changing v0.2.0.
Run a pinned 5–10 confirmed-source workflow and then a 30–50 source guided run.
Complete cohort reconciliation and the 100,000 eligible-light-curve target.
Keep all source-backed acquisition and scientific gates fail-closed.

knowledge_carried_forward: Issue #158 remains the sole active Park delivery tracker.
CPVS, CIN runtime, cross-platform packaging and unrelated platform work remain frozen.
The DR24 adapter is a bounded raw-native acquisition path, not a validated model-input path.
The v0.2.0 baseline, 42-feature schema, class order, historical cutoff and acceptance criteria remain unchanged.
The 100,000-light-curve target must not be claimed from the ALeRCE 2020 source count or the SCoPe DR16 light-curve count.
No Park model training or scientific validation is authorized by this audit.
